name: Coffee, Scrubs and Rubber Gloves Nurse Mug (14 oz)
seoTitle: Coffee Scrubs and Rubber Gloves Nurse Mug
metaDescription: A teal coffee mug with the Coffee, Scrubs and Rubber Gloves joke for nurses and med students. An easy gift for coffee lovers who live in scrubs.
summary: A teal mug that sums up nursing in three items: coffee, scrubs, and gloves. A cheerful, budget friendly gift for anyone fueled by caffeine on shift.
bestFor: Secret Santa at the nurses station
whyItWorks: Ask a nurse what gets them through the day and coffee will show up near the top of the list. Scrubs and gloves round out the uniform, which is why this simple three word joke works so well. It is relatable without being crude, so it is safe for a coworker gift exchange, a preceptor, or a student who is just starting clinicals.

Mugs earn their place by getting used, and a nurse who drinks a cup before a 7 a.m. report or during a 3 a.m. break will reach for a favorite one again and again. The 14 oz size listed in the title gives room for a proper refill. Fill it with individually wrapped coffee pods, a few granola bars, or a gift card to the coffee shop near the hospital for a complete little present. It also makes a nice addition to a unit break room if the team needs more mugs that are not chipped.
goodToKnow: Check the listing to confirm whether it is dishwasher and microwave safe.
Hospitals often ban open drinks on the floor, so this is mainly a home or break room mug.
Budget friendly enough to buy several for a unit or a nursing school cohort.

faq.q: Is this a good gift for a nursing student?
faq.a: Yes, the joke fits students in scrubs and clinicals just as well as working nurses. It is a nice pick for a new semester or a graduation basket.

faq.q: What pairs well with this mug?
faq.a: Coffee pods, a bag of local beans, or a small snack bundle all work. Compression socks or a funny badge reel also fit the theme.
